title: Vegan Egg Salad
method: Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas for 5 whistles and allow to cool
Mash the cooled chickpeas with onion, pickles and the jalapenos
Add in @boombayway vegan garlic mayo and sweet mustard and combine all the ingredients together
Salt + pepper as per your taste and finish with fresh cut coriander
Sourdough slices , crackers, canapes or as a salad
caption:
Vegan Egg Salad 
meal prep friendly | one bowl recipe

Ingredients
100 grams chickpea (raw weight), pressure cooked
1 onion, finely chopped
2 pickles, finely chopped
4-5 jalapeños, chopped
3 tbsp @boombayway vegan garlic mayo
1 tsp @boombayway sweet mustard
Salt + pepper to taste
Handful of coriander

Method
pressure cook the soaked chickpeas for 5 whistles and allow to cool
mash the cooled chickpeas with onion, pickles and the jalapenos
add in @boombayway vegan garlic mayo and sweet mustard and combine all the ingredients together
salt + pepper as per your taste and finish with fresh cut coriander
to serve
Sourdough slices , crackers, canapes or as a salad
